description: USB Type-C interface for RP2040 telemetry with ESD protection and series termination

USB_DP.description: USB D+ to RP2040 pin 47 (before 33Ω series resistor)

USB_DM.description: USB D- to RP2040 pin 46 (before 33Ω series resistor)

+3V3.description: 3.3V I/O supply for USB_VDD (RP2040 pin 48), decoupled with 100nF

GND.description: Ground reference, includes USB shield connection via ferrite bead + 1MΩ
